coverageNote: Initial check covers NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Teradyne. The remaining coverage universe is queued for daily checks; this is not a claim that every issuer has been scanned.

items.title: NVIDIA releases Q2 FY2027 results
items.fact: NVIDIA reported Data Center revenue of $89.0 billion for Q2 FY2027, up 117% year over year.
items.interpretation: This supplies operating evidence for the compute layer. Revenue growth alone does not establish any particular customer's capital spending.
items.transcriptStatus: Earnings call page located; latest transcript not verified

items.title: Microsoft publishes FY2026 Q4 earnings materials
items.fact: Microsoft's official earnings page provides the quarterly release, financial statements, and earnings-related downloads.
items.interpretation: Review cash purchases of property and equipment separately from finance leases before classifying a capital-expenditure event.
items.transcriptStatus: Transcript listed in earnings materials; contents not yet reviewed

items.title: Teradyne files second-quarter earnings exhibit
items.fact: The earnings release dated July 28 reports $100 million of Robotics revenue for Q2 2026. The issuer's SEC filing archive lists the exhibit under a July 29 8-K.
items.interpretation: The segment disclosure helps track commercial robotics demand. It does not identify individual robot orders or prove a backlog increase.
items.transcriptStatus: Webcast referenced in release; transcript not verified

items.title: AI infrastructure financing platform announcement
items.fact: NVIDIA's earnings release describes partnerships intended to mobilize third-party capital for AI infrastructure, subject to definitive agreements.
items.interpretation: Candidate financing event. Announced mobilization targets are not completed funding, deployed capital, or NVIDIA capital expenditures.
